service.description: The push gate. For a repository Smithy has, refuses a push (refs/for/* included): by an account without a confirmed address, or by no account; by an account suspended on the site; on a site that no longer mounts Smithy; to an archived repository; and one whose pack (packBytes) would take the repository past its namespace's size limit for one repository (the account's, or its nearest group's, else the site's default). What the repository stores is the framework's count (get#GitRepositoryUsage), asked for this repository alone; a push is refused when it cannot be read. A push that adds nothing (packBytes 0, deletes only) is not held to the size. A push to refs/for/[branch] (forReview; a page's proposal runs the same rule) needs view of a repository that takes merge requests and an account that is not silenced there; by an account without Developer it is at most 50 MiB, with at most 200 MiB of such pushes a day over every repository (and no more than one repository of the account's own may hold), counted against the pusher and not against the repository's limit, and it opens no more merge requests a day than the account's trust level allows (limitReached).

parameter.name: forReview
parameter.description: A ref of the push is refs/for/[branch]

parameter.name: pushOptions
parameter.description: The push's options: topic=[name] names the merge request a push to review goes to

parameter.name: refUpdates
parameter.description: The refs of the push: each with forReview and targetBranch for refs/for/[branch]

actions.script: for (const problem of ec.resource.script("component://mr-mantle/service/mantle/smithy/Smithy.js").checkPush({repositoryId, userId, packBytes, forReview, refUpdates, pushOptions})) ec.message.addError(problem)

service.description: The Git LFS upload check (the framework's check#GitLfsUpload contract): LFS uploads do not pass pre-receive, so for a repository Smithy has this refuses an upload by an account without a confirmed address or suspended on the site, on a site that no longer mounts Smithy, to an archived repository, when the usage cannot be read, and one whose bytes (uploadBytes) would take the Git LFS files of the repository's namespace (the account's repositories, or those below the group whose limit it is) past their limit.

actions.script: for (const problem of ec.resource.script("component://mr-mantle/service/mantle/smithy/Smithy.js").checkLfsUpload({repositoryId, userId, uploadBytes})) ec.message.addError(problem)

service.description: The git server's outbound check (git-server outbound-check-service, the framework's check#GitOutbound contract): asked before a repository's webhook deliveries are queued and before its push mirror pushes. For a repository Smithy has, holds them (allowed false, with the message) on a site that no longer mounts Smithy, for a hidden repository (by itself, a group above it or the repository it was forked from) and for a personal repository whose account is suspended on the site; what cannot be decided is held. Any other repository is allowed. A cheap read: it is asked of each push.

git-server rest-write-check-service (the framework's check#GitRestWrite contract): for a repository Smithy has, application smithy and restUrl Smithy's PASS REST of its site (/rest/s1/pass/v1/sites/[siteId]/smithy, on the site's canonical host when it has one); every write through the framework's REST is refused (allowed false, a message naming Smithy's REST), since Smithy's own operations keep its roles, confirmed address, gate and conversation; a read is allowed. Any other repository is allowed, with no application.

git-server offer-service (the framework's add#GitHostingOffer contract): the framework's offer with Smithy's REST for the site a client reaches (application: name smithy, restBase the site's /rest/s1/pass/v1/sites/[siteId]/smithy, siteId, pageUrl), forks true, for the site of the host the request came to, else of the server's own address, else the one published site that mounts Smithy; and Mantle's task source (tasks: kind moqui-rest, path /rest/s1/mantle/my/tasks) when the offer has none. Asked for callers with no credentials too: it names no account.

git-server agreement-check-service (the framework's check#GitAuthorSigned contract), over SmithyAgreementServices.get#AuthorSigned: for a repository Smithy has, whether the author (authorUserId or authorEmail) has signed its agreement file at the default branch, whether the repository requires it, what is missing, and signUrl, the file's edit page on the default branch. known is false for any other repository.

After a repository's default branch moved (the ref-update gitECA rule SmithyComponent): reads the component.xml at the root of its new commit and keeps the component's name, version and depends-on names on the SmithyRepository row (design-smithy §13.4), or clears them when the commit has none. Returns at once for a repository Smithy does not have and for a deleted branch. What it reads is cached by commit id.
